# contentful_app_event_subscription (Resource)

Manages a Contentful App Event Subscription.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "contentful_app_event_subscription" "this" {
  organization_id   = var.contentful_organization_id
  app_definition_id = var.app_definition_id

  topics     = ["Entry.publish", "Asset.publish"]
  target_url = "https://example.com/contentful/events"
}
```

## Ownership and changes

Contentful stores one subscription per App Definition in an organization. It applies across installations. Create and Update replace the whole subscription, even if another system created it. [Import](#import) an existing subscription before taking ownership. Writes have no version check, and destroy deletes the subscription as it exists at that moment.

## Replacement and recovery

If the plan replaces a subscription on the same App Definition, check the order. Creating first overwrites the existing subscription, and deleting the old instance then removes the new subscription. Terraform can [inherit `create_before_destroy` from a dependent resource](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/meta-arguments/lifecycle#create_before_destroy).

After a [failed write](../guides/operation-timeouts#recover-after-a-failed-write), inspect the subscription in Contentful and run `terraform plan`. A failed create can leave a tainted resource that Terraform proposes to replace. If Contentful created the subscription and Terraform has no record of it, import it.

## Function configuration

To use a handler Function instead of an HTTP target:

```terraform
resource "contentful_app_event_subscription" "this" {
  organization_id   = var.contentful_organization_id
  app_definition_id = var.app_definition_id

  topics                     = ["Entry.publish"]
  filter_function_id         = "eventFilter"
  transformation_function_id = "eventTransformation"
  handler_function_id        = "eventHandler"
}
```

HTTP delivery can also use filter and transformation Functions: configure
`target_url` and omit `handler_function_id`. This resource manages Function links;
deployment is handled separately.

Function links follow the documented API shape, but no successful live Function
configuration has been verified. Function removal and switching between HTTP and
handler destinations also remain unverified. If Contentful retains an omitted role
or target, the provider records the returned values and reports an error.

## Schema

### Required

- `app_definition_id` (String) ID of the App Definition. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization that owns the app. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `topics` (Set of String) Nonempty set of event topics, such as `Entry.publish`. Updates replace the complete set.

### Optional

- `filter_function_id` (String) ID of an `appevent.filter` Function that decides whether an event proceeds. Omission excludes this role from the subscription request.
- `handler_function_id` (String) ID of an `appevent.handler` Function used as the event destination instead of `target_url`. Omission excludes this role from the subscription request.
- `target_url` (String, Sensitive) HTTPS URL for event delivery. Omit when using `handler_function_id`. Marked sensitive and stored in Terraform state.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `transformation_function_id` (String) ID of an `appevent.transformation` Function that modifies the request before signing. Omission excludes this role from the subscription request.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource identifier in `organization_id/app_definition_id` form.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.
- `delete` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `read` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `update` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.

## Import

### By identity (Terraform 1.12 or later)

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    organization_id   = var.contentful_organization_id
    app_definition_id = var.app_definition_id
  }
  to = contentful_app_event_subscription.this
}
```

### By ID (Terraform 1.5 or later)

```terraform
import {
  id = "${var.contentful_organization_id}/${var.app_definition_id}"
  to = contentful_app_event_subscription.this
}
```

### From the command line

```shell
terraform import contentful_app_event_subscription.this "$CONTENTFUL_ORGANIZATION_ID/$CONTENTFUL_APP_DEFINITION_ID"
```
